title: GPUParticles2D: Emission shape deformed in 2D viewport when material has anim H or V frames
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.5.stable.flathub [876b29033] ### System information Godot v4.5.stable (876b29033) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 620 (KBL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7500U CPU @ 2.70GHz (4 threads) - 15.38 GiB memory ### Issue description The following GPUParticles2D particle effect is made with: - A ParticleProcessMaterial with emission shape Sphere - A CanvasItemMaterial with particles animation activated and particles anim H frames set to 5 - A texture which is a sprite sheet with 5 horizontal frames [Screencast from 2025-09-12 14-27-45.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/decb6374-2981-4d98-8823-3b3be57f7f01) It works fine, but both the emission shape and the visibility rect are deformed in the 2D viewport, by exactly the amount of frames. So the Sphere shape that should be drawn as a circle is drawn as an ellipse: And playing with the particle anim H frames I see that this is deforming the viewport drawing: [Grabación de pantalla desde 2025-10-15 07-05-41.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/91f6841e-dba2-4d93-9293-2eab06d90180) ### Steps to reproduce - Add a GPUParticles2D node - Add ParticleProcessMaterial, set emission shape to Sphere - Add a CanvasItemMaterial, enable particles animation, set particles anim H frames set to 5 The viewport should display a circle, not an ellipse. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [gpu-particles-mrp_2025-10-15_07-52-53.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22925183/gpu-particles-mrp_2025-10-15_07-52-53.zip)
